parsed.internal_thinking: I need to balance my production. My first settlement at node 12 gives me Wood, Brick, and Sheep. To win, I need cities and development cards, which require Ore (אבן) and Wheat (חיטה). Jimmy is already strong there. Node 25 is the best available spot: it gives me Wheat 8 (5 pips), Ore 3 (2 pips), and Sheep 4 (3 pips), totaling 10 pips. It also secures a different Ore source than Jimmy's 5. This rounds out my resources perfectly for the second round setup.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed second settlement at node 25 (Wheat 8, Ore 3, Sheep 4). This gives me all resources except Wood/Brick from this spot, but I have Wood and Brick from my first settlement. I am now set up for a balanced game.
parsed.say_outloud: טוב, אני אלך על הפינה הזאת. קצת חיטה, קצת אבן, ואפילו עוד כמה כבשים לאוסף. ג'ימי, אל תדאג, אני משאיר לך מספיק מקום בדרום.
